description: This Java source file defines the 'ImageDetailActivity' class, which is a activity for displaying images in a full-screen, swipeable ViewPager with additional UI controls such as an action bar and menu options. It handles setting up image caching, image loading via 'ImageFetcher', and user interactions for immersive photo viewing within an Android application.

classes.name: ImageDetailActivity
classes.description: An activity displaying images in a swipeable full-screen ViewPager with caching and immersive UI features.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up image cache, ViewPager, and UI controls, and configures immersive mode.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the activity and resumes image loading tasks.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the activity and halts image loading, also flushes cache.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with image cache.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, such as navigating up or clearing cache.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu layout into the activity.

methods.name: getImageFetcher
methods.description: Provides access to the ImageFetcher instance for loading images.
